name: How much does it cost to disconnect and cap a gas line?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to disconnect and cap a gas line?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to disconnect and cap a gas line can vary depending on factors such as the complexity of the job, the location of the gas line, and whether it's an emergency service. Generally, you can expect a service call fee plus labor. For an accurate estimate, it's best to contact a local plumbing service for a consultation. Many companies offer transparent pricing after assessing the situation. Alpha-Plumbing Services provides upfront estimates for gas line work in Goodyear, Buckeye, Avondale, Surprise, and Waddell.
